title: Former NISA Chief: Saudi-Turkey-Pakistan Trilateral Defense Pact Could Bolster Somalia Security
detail: Former National Intelligence and Security Agency (NISA) director says an emerging Saudi-Turkey-Pakistan trilateral defense pact could significantly bolster Somalia's security capacity. The proposed alignment between three major Muslim-majority nations with established ties to Mogadishu could provide expanded training, equipment, and intelligence-sharing frameworks for Somali security forces in their ongoing counter-insurgency effort against al-Shabaab.
